name: Qualitau Ltd
summary: Qualitau Ltd engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of test equipment and services for use in the semiconductor industry for European and Far-Eastern markets. The company provides reliability test systems, including package and wafer-level multi-application testing, package level pulse EM and BTS testing, package and wafer-level TDDB and HC testing, multi-site parallel wafer-level probing systems, and semi-auto probers. It also offers fast parametric testers, high voltage HTRB/H3TRB products, and desktop micro-oven systems, as well as test lab services. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Ness Ziona, Israel.
